content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates without the essential qualifications; their applications are cancelled automatically. Only candidates who can join immediately need to apply.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) in Public Health Dentistry. Experience required: Two-year experience of epidemiological data collection in the field and minimum one-year experience in managerial capacity for research projects. Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Pay: As per ICMR rules. Qualification required: Graduate Degree in Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS). Experience required: Two-year experience of epidemiological data collection in the field. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: As per ICMR rules.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Salary and allowances will be as per AIIMS/ICMR/GOI guidelines. Initially up to 31st March 2027, extendable based on project requirements and funding availability. Performance reviewed every 30 days; contract terminable with one day's notice if found unsatisfactory.

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on percentage marks in essential and desirable qualifications and experience in 1:5 ratio Written test / computer exercises / clinical examination (if required) Personal interview Merit list prepared based on percentage marks in essential qualification, desirable qualifications, and experience. Only 1:5 shortlisted candidates invited for physical interview per post.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Printout of filled Google form Self-attested copies of all educational and experience certificates Valid ID proof Signed declaration form Detailed C.V.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Fill out the Google Form using the link or QR code provided in the notice. Upload scanned copies of application form and supporting documents online. Send a hard copy of the application form, experience certificates, age proof, educational qualifications, and detailed C.V. by post. Label the envelope as 'Application for the post of [Post Name] under National Oral Disease Burden Survey'. Apply on or before 11 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Submission of documents by both post and Google Form is mandatory. Separate applications must be submitted if applying for more than one post.

content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of All India Institute of Medical Sciences New Delhi, dated 28 October 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies: 8 Project Research Scientist-II (Medical - MDS, for outstation fieldwork), 4 Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) (BDS, for outstation fieldwork).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Project Research Scientist-II (Medical - MDS, for outstation fieldwork): maximum 40 years; Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) (BDS, for outstation fieldwork): maximum 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per ICMR rules for Project Research Scientist-II (Medical - MDS, for outstation fieldwork), As per ICMR rules for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) (BDS, for outstation fieldwork).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) in Public Health Dentistry or Graduate Degree in Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Extensive travel across different states of India is required. No arrangement for returning to Delhi between field visits. Private practice, tuition, coaching, or online classes are strictly banned during employment. Must be able to join immediately or within 15 days of issue of offer letter.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without the essential qualifications; their applications are cancelled automatically. Only candidates who can join immediately need to apply.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on percentage marks in essential and desirable qualifications and experience in 1:5 ratio. Written test / computer exercises / clinical examination (if required). Personal interview. Merit list prepared based on percentage marks in essential qualification, desirable qualifications, and experience.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially up to 31st March 2027, extendable based on project requirements and funding availability. Performance reviewed every 30 days; contract terminable with one day's notice if found unsatisfactory.
